body:
## Summary
The outbound-relay capability bit is cached module-wide for the life of the page on the stated premise that it 'only changes with a server restart' — but the relay has been UI-configurable from this very context for a while. Saving a relay in Channels leaves every one of 11 consumers (pipeline drawer, decisions, scheduler, analytics) saying 'queued, nothing will deliver' until a hard reload. Move the cache into a pure, invalidatable store and let the relay editor push the invalidation.

## Description
`useDeliveryCapability.ts` owns `cached`/`inflight` as module state with no way to clear them. The relay editor (`ChannelsRelayConfigCard.tsx`) is the only place in the product where that fact changes, and it tells nobody: not the capability cache, not the live-refresh bus. The Comms ledger beside it derives the same fact a third way (from `/api/comms`) and only re-reads on live-refresh, so right after a successful save the pane shows a green On badge above a red 'relay not configured' alert. The structural move is to make the capability a live read with a pushed invalidation, per swr-design ('a pushed invalidation event overrides any TTL ... the timer is the fallback'): a DOM-free `deliveryCapabilityCache.ts` (get / invalidate / subscribe, in-flight dedupe, a generation guard so a pre-invalidation answer never lands as final, a DEDICATED cross-window message type rather than the untyped data-changed bus) under an unchanged hook signature. The relay card calls `invalidateCommsCapability()` + `notifyDataChanged()` on save and on the 409 adopt.

## Flow
1. Extract the fetch/cache/in-flight logic from `useDeliveryCapability.ts` into `deliveryCapabilityCache.ts` with an injectable fetcher and channel, keeping the UNKNOWN-is-not-cached rule.
2. Add `invalidate()` with a generation counter and a subscriber set; broadcast a `capability-changed` message on its own BroadcastChannel name so other windows invalidate too, without listening to the general `changed` message.
3. Rewire the hook to subscribe to the store (same return shape; no consumer edits).
4. In `ChannelsRelayConfigCard.tsx` save(): on the ok branch and the 409 branch call `invalidateCommsCapability()` and `notifyDataChanged()` so the ledger alert and all capability consumers re-read.
5. Fix the 'only change with a server restart' comment and update the capability row in `docs/features/comms/README.md`.

## Expected impact
The delivery-honesty vocabulary ('sent' vs 'queued') becomes true across every tab within one round-trip of an operator saving or clearing a relay, instead of lying until a reload — in both directions (clearing a relay currently keeps claiming delivery). Closes a whole class: any future runtime-configurable capability bit gets an invalidation door instead of a restart assumption. One read per page still holds when nothing changes.

## Evaluation
Claim: the relay capability seen by client surfaces follows a relay save without a page reload, with no extra reads when nothing changes.
Before: 0 of 8 acceptance cases pass
After: 8 of 8

body:
## Summary
A receiver today is either Waiting or Listening. Listening means one authenticated POST ever arrived — including a Zapier test ping followed by a week of 422s — and the pull half the server already projects on every row (pull URL, last pull, last pull error) is shown nowhere and cannot be edited. Give every receiver a health verdict the recruiter can act on, and put the pull-source editor on the selected receiver, in the pane where the problem is seen.

## Description
The candidate-communication-integrity standard models a channel as not configured / configured-but-unverified / verified, and only verified may be trusted. The Channels tab collapses the middle two: `isReceiverLive` is connectivity, not delivery, and its own comment names 'live-but-broken' as the state the recruiter must see — yet the row badge and the section badge both paint it green. Meanwhile the L0 pull mechanism (the answer to 'my studio was closed at 22:00') is fully built server-side and fully invisible: the doc lists it as a known gap. This card adds `receiverHealth.ts` (waiting / reachedNoLeads / delivering / pullFailing, plus a section roll-up that extends `statusFor` with a caution 'Needs attention') and `receiverPullForm.ts` (the PATCH body under the repo's keep/clear/replace secret contract, the blank-save-on-unknown guard the relay and edge cards already carry, coded refusals). `ChannelsReceiverPullCard.tsx` renders under the selected row in both the Email and Ad-forms panes, modelled on the Edge card: URL, write-only bearer, last pull time, and a failing pull headlined as a localized sentence with the raw error shown as code-styled data.

## Flow
1. Recruiter opens Channels; the Email section badge reads 'Needs attention' instead of green Listening because one receiver's pull has failed since Tuesday.
2. The receiver table's status column shows that row as 'Pull failing' (critical) and another as 'Reached — no candidate filed' (caution); healthy rows read Delivering.
3. Clicking the failing row selects it; below the setup guide the pull card shows the URL, 'secret set', last pull 3 days ago, and the error class with 'HTTP 502' as data.
4. The recruiter corrects the URL or rotates the bearer and saves; the PATCH answers `{ pull }`, the tab lists reload, and the verdict clears on the next clean pull (lastPullError nulls on write per setChannelPull).
5. For a 'reached, no leads' row the card points to the CV-sim action already in the pane to reproduce a real application.

## Expected impact
The most expensive silent failure on this surface — an integration that connects but files nobody, or a pull source that stopped days ago — becomes visible at the section tab and fixable in place, without a curl against an undocumented PATCH. Closes a documented known gap (comms README) and the open leftover item, and makes the 'Listening' claim stop outrunning the record.

## Evaluation
Claim: a receiver's health is stated as an actionable verdict and its pull half is editable from the receiver pane, with no destructive blank save and no server prose rendered as a sentence.
Before: 0 of 8 acceptance cases pass
After: 8 of 8
Method: gate
Result: pending
Gate: none
